apps.name: Khidma Desk
apps.description: Service customers, job status, estimates and manually entered payment notes.

apps.name: Archive Lab
apps.description: Exercise record create/edit, portable backup, validation and restore behavior.

modules.name: Portable Archive
modules.role: Versioned JSON envelope, SHA-256 integrity checks, bounded imports and migration hooks.
modules.evidence: 15 focused unit tests; used by two app consumers.

modules.name: Record Vault
modules.role: Storage-compatible record store with one-key persistence and archive restore.
modules.evidence: 15 focused unit tests; Chromium workflows run through Archive Lab.

modules.name: Khidma Core
modules.role: Customer/job schemas, job transitions, DZD estimate and manual-payment invariants.
modules.evidence: 12 domain tests; consumed by Khidma Desk.

integrations.name: GitHub
integrations.summary: Source control, pull requests, CI runs and release evidence.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Not wired to this browser app
integrations.recommendation: Use for source-of-truth, review and release gates.

integrations.name: Vercel
integrations.summary: Git-connected previews, static hosting and deploy inspection.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Project deployment being configured separately
integrations.recommendation: Use Git integration for the Personal OS shell; keep secrets out of the static frontend.

integrations.name: Supabase
integrations.summary: Postgres-backed data, authentication, object storage and realtime capabilities.
integrations.appIntegrationState: No app-side project or credentials configured
integrations.recommendation: Candidate for a first cloud-sync adapter after the data/identity model and row-level security are specified.

integrations.name: Neon
integrations.summary: Managed PostgreSQL with branches and database-level portability.
integrations.appIntegrationState: No app-side database adapter configured
integrations.recommendation: Candidate when a managed PostgreSQL database is preferred and auth/storage are handled separately.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.summary: Knowledge capture, planning and source-document workflows.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Workspace connector available; not connected in this app
integrations.recommendation: Use as an external knowledge workspace or link target; keep exportable copies of core schemas.

integrations.name: Airtable
integrations.summary: Structured tables and operational tracking.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Workspace connector available; not connected in this app
integrations.recommendation: Useful for import/export and reference workflows; avoid making it the only canonical store.

integrations.name: Figma
integrations.summary: Interface design, design context and collaboration.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Workspace connector available; not connected in this app
integrations.recommendation: Keep design specifications and design tokens exportable.

integrations.name: Canva
integrations.summary: Visual assets, brand collateral and publish-ready creative.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Workspace connector available; not connected in this app
integrations.recommendation: Use as a production tool, not as a data or identity backend.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.summary: Speech, voice agents and audio generation workflows.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Workspace connector available; not connected in this app
integrations.recommendation: Add behind a capability adapter only when a real voice/audio workflow needs it.

integrations.name: Appwrite
integrations.summary: Self-hostable backend components for authentication, databases, storage and functions.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Full backend alternative; compare deployment footprint and provider lock-in with Supabase.

integrations.name: PocketBase
integrations.summary: Small self-hosted backend built around SQLite with auth and file storage.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Good lightweight local/self-hosted experiment; validate current release maturity and migration expectations before important data.

integrations.name: Activepieces
integrations.summary: Workflow automation and agent/MCP integrations. Review feature boundaries before reuse.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Preferred first automation candidate to evaluate, subject to the exact Community Edition feature and license boundary.

integrations.name: Flowise
integrations.license: Apache-2.0 core; enterprise directories/files are commercial
integrations.summary: Visual LLM workflow and agent builder that can expose workflows as APIs or tools.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Keep as an optional separate service; review excluded enterprise paths and transitive dependencies.

integrations.name: Appsmith
integrations.summary: Visual builder for dashboards and internal CRUD tools over APIs and databases.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Use for a quick private admin console if the first-party interface becomes a bottleneck; keep domain logic outside it.

integrations.name: Penpot
integrations.summary: Open-source design and prototyping workspace for UI and design systems.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Reference candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Prefer for portable design assets and inspectable design tokens when self-hosting matters.

integrations.name: AppFlowy
integrations.summary: Separate knowledge/workspace app with projects, wiki and collaborative building blocks.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Separate application candidate; do not embed without copyleft review
integrations.recommendation: Evaluate as a standalone personal service rather than copying components into the MIT codebase.

integrations.name: Puter
integrations.summary: Self-hosted browser desktop and app platform; an alternative platform shape, not just a reusable component.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Separate platform candidate; not part of this deployment
integrations.recommendation: Use as a reference or independent self-hosted stack; evaluate its complete service footprint and AGPL obligations first.

integrations.name: n8n
integrations.license: Sustainable Use License; not OSI open source
integrations.summary: Automation platform with restrictions; useful for permitted personal/internal experiments, not an unrestricted code-reuse candidate.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Separate service only; check use case terms
integrations.recommendation: Keep optional for personal/internal automation; do not classify it as MIT/OSI open source or embed it as a universal dependency.

integrations.name: NocoDB
integrations.license: Sustainable Use License; not OSI open source
integrations.summary: Spreadsheet-like interface over databases with commercial-use restrictions to review.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Separate service only; check use case terms
integrations.recommendation: Optional standalone personal experiment; not a permissive-license code-reuse default.

integrations.name: SQLite
integrations.summary: Embedded relational data store for local/offline apps.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Foundation candidate; no application adapter selected
integrations.recommendation: Excellent local data foundation if the application architecture needs relational queries; separate build tooling can have its own terms.

integrations.name: Drizzle ORM
integrations.summary: Typed SQL-first ORM for Postgres and other SQL engines.
integrations.appIntegrationState: Foundation candidate; not configured
integrations.recommendation: Consider only when backend SQL schema/code justifies an ORM; prefer direct SQL and migrations until then.
